business_summary: Hansaemk Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells women's, men's, and kid's casual clothes and golf wear in South Korea and internationally. The company sells its products under the NBA, BUCKAROO, CURLYSUE, MOIMOLN, PLAYKIZ-PRO, NBA KIDS, LEVI'S KIDS, and PGA TOUR & LPGA brands. The company was formerly known as MK Trend Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hansaemk Co.,Ltd. in August 2017. Hansaemk Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Hansaemk Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hansae Yes24 Holdings Co., Ltd.
